quarterly_data.signal: Half-year report: H1 2026 consolidated revenue KRW 268,803,713,294 versus KRW 175,192,361,143 in H1 2025; H1 operating profit KRW 58,332,574,571 versus KRW 23,393,042,666; H1 net profit KRW 52,721,085,303 versus KRW 18,835,838,112. Q2 2026 revenue KRW 112,688,832,955 (Q2 2025: KRW 97,529,632,802) and Q2 operating profit KRW 23,521,741,082 (Q2 2025: KRW 15,557,553,762). H1 revenue already equals most of FY2025 revenue of KRW 382,856,574,357.

Mix, H1 2026: semiconductor segment (CMP polishing equipment, CMP slurries, wet cleaning systems) KRW 252,031,346 thousand or 93.8% of revenue (H1 2025: KRW 155,037,663 thousand); display segment (wet stations, coaters) KRW 16,758,215 thousand or 6.2%. By type, equipment-build revenue was KRW 167,612,581 thousand (H1 2025: KRW 87,023,038 thousand) and product sales (slurries and materials) KRW 85,492,659 thousand (H1 2025: KRW 77,508,754 thousand). By region, Korea KRW 238,758,948 thousand (88.8%), China KRW 21,555,051 thousand (8.0%, down from KRW 43,681,582 thousand or 24.9% a year earlier) and the US KRW 8,477,605 thousand (3.2%).
quarterly_data.figure: semiconductor KRW 252,031,346 thousand (93.8%); equipment-build revenue KRW 167,612,581 thousand; product sales KRW 85,492,659 thousand; China KRW 21,555,051 thousand (8.0%)

quarterly_data.signal: Order backlog (equipment contracts recognised over time) was KRW 34,500,592 thousand at June 30, 2026 (semiconductor KRW 31,442,964 thousand, display KRW 3,057,628 thousand) versus KRW 37,531,873 thousand at end-2025; new orders in H1 2026 were KRW 164,581,300 thousand, of which semiconductor KRW 166,945,725 thousand (display orders were reduced by KRW 2,364,425 thousand).
quarterly_data.figure: backlog KRW 34,500,592 thousand; H1 new orders KRW 164,581,300 thousand (semiconductor KRW 166,945,725 thousand)

quarterly_data.signal: Customer concentration: two customers each exceeded 10% of revenue in H1 2026, customer A with KRW 103,656M and customer B with KRW 140,406M (H1 2025: KRW 92,991M and KRW 58,771M); the note does not name them. Sales are mostly to domestic customers whose investment plans set the equipment specifications; overseas sales are mainly through bids to existing accounts.
quarterly_data.figure: customer A KRW 103,656M; customer B KRW 140,406M (H1 2025 KRW 92,991M / KRW 58,771M)

quarterly_data.signal: Capex and R&D: H1 2026 cash paid for PP&E was KRW 21,628,467,581 (H1 2025: KRW 8,577,088,927) and construction in progress rose to KRW 33,131,435 thousand from KRW 19,978,411 thousand; the board approved a PP&E acquisition on 2026-03-24 and two PP&E investments on 2026-08-05 (amounts not stated). H1 R&D spending was KRW 24,896,667 thousand (9.26% of revenue). Next-generation CMP work listed in the report includes a next carrier, KOPC, multi-optic-sensor profile control and advanced IPCS edge control; the US subsidiary KCTech America (Oregon) develops slurry and chemical products for US customers. Capacity is not disclosed (trade secret).
